A <c:ffff00>Leg Type<c> that moves on treads. Only tanks can't
<c:ffff00>evade<c>, but they can <c:ffff00>defend<c> instead. Stable on any
{{terrain}}, they tend toward high <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c> and <c:ffff00>Heavy<c>
<c:ffff00>Limit<c>.

<c:ffff00>{{terrain|cap}} {{affinity|cap}}<c> (<c:ffff00>{{mobility}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c>):
  <c:ffff00>{{plains}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{forest}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{rocky_ground}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{sand}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{tundra}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{hall}}<c>
  and <c:ffff00>{{waterside}}<c>: 0. <c:ffff00>{{cyber}}<c>: +4.
  <c:ffff00>{{underwater}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{sky}}<c>: {{robattle|pl}} not possible.
